summary: Fixed the exit-141 SIGPIPE crash in literature-briefing.sh's repo mode by replacing two jq-into-head-1 pipelines (parent_entry lookup at the former :238-241 strict site and :245-247 fallback site) with jq -c 'first(.entries[] | select(...))', removing head from both pipelines. All 4 phases completed: Phase 1 captured a pre-fix baseline (live 141 reproduction against the real horty_2001_agency-and-deontic-logic entry, via a scratch harness built after discovering the plan's literal cd+absolute-path invocation cannot reach repo mode -- literature-briefing.sh resolves PROJECT_ROOT from its own on-disk location, not $PWD). Phase 2 applied the fix (bash -n clean, head -1 count 10->8, parent_entry structure intact at exactly 4 references, (.id // .doc_id) tolerance preserved). Phase 3 audited the remaining 8 head -1 sites and confirmed all are scalar-emitting (no further changes needed). Phase 4 re-ran the fixed script against the same real data: exit 0, 52/52 documents resolved including horty_2001, lit-coverage marker well-formed, second unrelated query also exits 0, deploy copy (.claude/scripts/literature-briefing.sh) confirmed untouched. Only agent-system/extensions/literature/scripts/literature-briefing.sh was modified.
